title: Is the MSFS 2024 Marketplace worth it this week? | Bristol T188 & new upgrades evaluated
description:
Are you looking to invest in your Microsoft Flight Simulator 2024 hangar this week, or are you just trying to navigate past the landmines on the virtual storefront? Today, we are breaking down a massive wave of recent Marketplace developments that represent a monumental shift for deep simulation fidelity and custom environments.

We dive deep into the triumphant return of a legendary heavy-hitting historic classic: the supersonic Bristol T188 "Flaming Pencil" research jet developed by TG Sims. Built with a unique stainless steel fuselage designed to conquer the thermal challenges of high-Mach flight, we look at its raw speed, authentic interior instrumentation layout, and functional landing parachute system.

Next, we shift focus to a rugged vintage workhorse making a splash: the RAF SE5A biplane fighter by Captain Sim. We break down the structural implementation of this classic World War I design, evaluating the clarity of its high-resolution 8K textures, custom historical liveries, dedicated painting kit, and the overall behavior of its specialized atmospheric flight model.

If you want to breathe completely new life into your everyday narrow-body airline flights, we evaluate the massive cockpit light enhancement suite from Two Pilot. Say goodbye to default visibility limits with refined dynamic instrument illumination profiles for the Cessna Citation CJ4, Citation Longitude, Cirrus Vision Jet, and Pilatus PC-24. Plus, we look at a sleek cosmetic optimization pack that converts standard wings with custom 4K metal liveries for the Antonov AN-2 and an extensive 34-livery British Airways pack for the ATR 42/600 and 72/600 Expert Series.

If you enjoy honest, data-driven, and critical looks at the Flight Simulator Marketplace without the fluff, make sure to hit that like button, subscribe to the channel, and drop a comment below letting us know what's in your hangar!
